one_line_takeaway: Let the inciting opportunity be something the protagonist actively wants, so the audience becomes complicit in the deception and tension compounds with every win.
structural_pattern: Slow infiltration setup where each small victory raises the cost of exposure; a literal descent at the midpoint flips comedy into dread; the climax detonates at a celebration, the least safe 'safe' place.

one_line_takeaway: Define victory as self-respect rather than winning, so the ending can satisfy even when the protagonist loses the surface contest.
structural_pattern: Long humble-life setup before the opportunity arrives unearned; training montage doubles as relationship deepening; final contest intercuts physical endurance with emotional stakes established in act one.

one_line_takeaway: Frame family/institutional pressure as the true antagonist, letting individual authority figures remain human and even sympathetic.
structural_pattern: Present-day search frames past-tense friendship story; comic set pieces each encode one thesis point about education pressure; a suicide-adjacent crisis is the act-two low; reunion resolution pays off a years-long mystery.

one_line_takeaway: Let a broken household heal one pairwise relationship at a time — each brother's arc unlocks the next — instead of a single group reconciliation scene.
structural_pattern: Ensemble setup establishes each member's private shame; an outsider entering the home is the inciting force; the antagonist is a 'respectable' patriarch whose menace escalates quietly; climax converges all arcs at the house.

one_line_takeaway: Withhold confrontation entirely; let meaning accumulate through routine, small courtesies, and what characters pointedly do not say.
structural_pattern: Episodic visits replace plot beats; disappointment is distributed across many small scenes rather than one betrayal; death arrives off-screen late and reframes every earlier scene; resolution is acceptance, not change.

one_line_takeaway: Make the mentor's sacrifice the engine: every act of teaching costs him something material, so knowledge transfer itself carries dramatic stakes.
structural_pattern: Talented-outsider setup denied by class barriers; midpoint pivot from personal ambition to collective uplift; institutional antagonists escalate from mockery to violence; exam-as-battle climax.

one_line_takeaway: Give the antagonist authorship of the plot — the protagonist's investigation is itself the trap — so the twist recontextualizes agency, not just facts.
structural_pattern: Compressed brutal inciting stretch (imprisonment) shown as montage; investigation structured as a breadcrumb trail laid by the enemy; tonal genre-blend of absurd comedy inside violence; revelation lands as moral catastrophe, not victory.

one_line_takeaway: Ground each episode in one mundane, hyper-specific student problem (a batch change, a lost notebook) and let the emotional arc ride on it — relatability is the hook, not plot.
structural_pattern: Each episode: small practical problem → escalation through peer/institutional friction → mentor monologue reframes it → quiet emotional beat with a friend. Episode hooks are unresolved anxieties, not cliffhangers. Season arc: innocence eroding across episodes.

one_line_takeaway: Let the reluctant protagonist's contempt for his situation slowly become investment, one absurd local problem at a time — the season arc is an attitude change, not an event.
structural_pattern: Fish-out-of-water setup; each episode is a self-contained village problem with a comic escalation and a humane resolution; finale withholds the escape the protagonist wanted, revealing he no longer fully wants it.

one_line_takeaway: Sustain a slow emotional burn by making the obstacle structural (a border, a duty) rather than a misunderstanding — so intimacy grows in small domestic scenes while the threat stays external.
structural_pattern: High-concept inciting accident; long middle of enforced cohabitation building intimacy through care rituals; episode hooks alternate between romantic near-misses and external danger; separation before reunion finale.

one_line_takeaway: Use direct-address as a defense mechanism the narrative eventually turns against the narrator — the style itself becomes the character's arc.
structural_pattern: Comic episodic surface hides a withheld traumatic backstory revealed in fragments; the penultimate episode detonates the withheld truth; finale strips the protagonist of her audience-facing armor.

one_line_takeaway: Open with the counterintuitive claim stated as fact in the first two seconds, then make the viewer earn the explanation by watching the middle.
structural_pattern: 0-3s bold claim or pattern interrupt; 3-15s stakes ('why this matters to you'); 15-40s the mechanism explained with one concrete example; final 5s callback to the opening claim plus soft CTA.

one_line_takeaway: Start at the moment of maximum drama mid-story ('so the police officer is holding my phone...') then rewind — the open loop is the retention engine.
structural_pattern: Cold open at the crisis point; rewind to compressed setup; escalate back to the opening moment with new context; payoff exceeds or subverts what the opening implied; twist beat before CTA.

one_line_takeaway: Show the 'after' state in the first frame as proof, then sell the journey — viewers stay for process, not outcome.
structural_pattern: 0-2s after-state flash; 2-10s before-state with relatable pain; middle is compressed process with visible incremental wins; end on side-by-side comparison and one actionable takeaway.

one_line_takeaway: Establish the absurd premise inside the first line of dialogue and escalate the same joke three times, each faster — the third escalation is the share trigger.
structural_pattern: Premise in one line; rule-of-three escalation with rising absurdity and shrinking beat length; final beat breaks the established pattern for the punchline; no CTA — the loop rewatch is the CTA.
